review.headline: leaves my teeth sparkly clean and white
review.reviewBody:
iO9 Series Black Onyx electronic toothbrush is the most unique and helpful toothbrush I've ever owned and used. The design of the toothbrush is modern, sleek, digital with images and even shows hello message and a happy face! The best part is that it cleans my teeth so well - I am blown away by the results everytime. All I had to do was install an app called OB professional on my phone and connect using bluetooth. The setup was super easy and I immediately went into brushing my teeth. I really liked that I was able to see an image of teeth on the app and the more I covered certain areas the more whiter the teeth on the image would become. Furthermore, it detects everytime you move the toothbrush to a different area or angle the toothbrush from inside of the teeth to the outside. It's truly incredible how far technology and this toothbrush has taken us. I was able to select between 7 different modes: daily clean, whiten teeth, tongue cleaning, gum care, sensitive, super sensitive and intense. To cover 16 zones around my mouth it took me about 4 minutes. At 5 minutes the toothbrush automatically would turn off. Also, in the app I'm able to select a reminder for flossing, tongue cleaning, and mouthwash. This toothbrush came with 4 replacement heads, a charging travel case with a cord that connects to the traveling case and a separate magnetic charging stand. When charging the toothbrush the screen shows a bar level and a digital number depicting how much the toothbrush is charged. After so many years brushing my teeth and going to the dentist, who knew I could learn something from a toothbrush like this one?! I was able to customize a color on this toothbrush and while brushing it lets me know based on green light, customized color or red warning color if I'm going too hard on my gums. To protect my gums and teeth further in the future, this is such a helpful feature! Another plus to this toothbrush as I brush my teeth is that it gives me a report at the end. The report shows me how I did on brushing my teeth and if I missed any spots the visible image of the teeth is shown during brushing process and it gives me a percent when I went a bit too hard on the gums to improve for future. It also helps that it's lightweight, water proof, and easy to use around the mouth. The bristles are far from anything I've ever used before. I'm used to long and angled bristles. However, these toothbrush heads are unique as they really work on each and different tooth and angles. When cleaning my tongue it's a very quick process and really does a fabulous job leaving my whole mouth clean. This toothbrush leaves my sparkly white teeth so smooth and clean almost as if I left my dentist's office for a cleaning. I honestly wish I have discovered this toothbrush few years ago when I was going through invisalign treatment as I had to brush my teeth a million times a day. This toothbrush is truly the way to maintain good health and healthy teeth. After using this toothbrush for 2 weeks I've noticed how much whiter my teeth have gotten to be. Forget whitening my teeth, simply brushing my teeth 3 times a day does it! I loved that while using this toothbrush it was not loud and did not wake up my newborn! My young kids have loved watching me use this toothbrush so much that they are requesting for one for them for the holidays! The two things I would improve about this toothbrush is for the traveling case to have a UV light to sanitize the toothbrush and to make room for 2 brush heads for those that love to travel with their significant other and love to share their case. As right now I'm only able to place one toothbrush head in the traveling case. In addition, I would love to see more different colors for this particular toothbrush like purple, royal blue and green.
Overall, magnificent electronic toothbrush that I cannot say enough positive things about! Very impressive!

review.headline: Extremely Messy!!
review.reviewBody: I bought this toothbrush at Costco as a Christmas gift for my wife and I, it is the worse investment I ever made. It’s so messy, tooth paste just runs down the toothbrush and all over your hands. DON’T YOU DARE ATTEMPT TO TAKE ONE STEP AWAY FROM THE SINK OR YOU WILL BE SORRY!! After you rinse off the toothbrush from brushing your teeth and place it on the charger, toothpaste continues to just pile up.

review.headline: Unbelievably good iO toothbrush!
review.reviewBody: I tried this at CES a few months ago.  It is amazing and I couldn't wait to get it for myself.  I always considered myself as a good brusher-but with this iO brush, it's surprising how much cleaner my mouth feels.  It's super smooth, and a lot less high pitched 'mosquito buzzing' of my old brush.  The ability to real time track how I'm brushing-that's a cool gamification.  Brushing my teeth is less of a chore.  One thing I didn't know at the beginning was that you should go tooth to tooth, and let the brush do the work-that's my helpful tip to future buyers!! I highly recommend iO!

review.headline: Not Recommended. Used for 1 year
review.reviewBody: Motion sensor on toothbrush will continuously drain the battery when the toothbrush moves around in case or bag. Any slight movement will turn on display. Must charge DAILY which is very inconvenient for traveler.

review.headline: Dental hygienist approved!
review.reviewBody: As a dental hygienist, I get to try all of the latest technologies and products of all brands. This is by far my favorite product I’ve experienced for myself AND my patients. I have noticed minimal plaque and bleeding areas in my patients that are using the IO toothbrush (correctly). If I have a patient that says they don’t like the brush, I show them how to properly use it. More than 9/10, they were using it incorrectly & end up loving the brush after proper use. Ask your dental professional for advice!! I believe in this brush from personal and professional experience and recommend it to all of my patients, friends, and family!

review.headline: Great Brushing for an Electric Toothbrush
review.reviewBody: I bought this as many studies have this is more effective than a manual toothbrush. Though Oral B and Sonicare are two of the top brand, I chose the Oral B instead because of its appeal and heavily marketing to be a better toothbrush when it comes to cleaning due to their oscillation motion. Though there are a lot of benefits to talk about, I WILL ONLY TELL YOU WHAT I DISLIKE ABOUT THIS ELECTRIC TOOTHBRUSH. First, it is messy if you don't be careful with this and I also find it odd that whenever I finished cleaning the head of the toothbrush there will be some amount of water leftover dripping down from inside of the toothbrush as a result, making it stained wherever you put it. Second, the app technology is great but I doubt the real-time tracking brushing will do any good, as they fail to capture the motion as which spot I have the toothbrush at when I already move to the next one leading you to brush your teeth longer could do some harm or good in the long run. Overall, it's a decent product that comes at a premium price with some unnecessary features that you may not need.

review.headline: Black mold. bad design.
review.reviewBody: Black mold continues to occur within both the OralB iO9 handle top and brushhead bottom where it attaches to handle. OralB should consider a better design with antimicrobial technology (like Microban® ). As a 20+ year OralB electric toothbrush user, I've never had mold issues with OralB Pro 1000 which is a better anti-mold design. With me being in ortho braces currently, the iO9 definitely cleans my teeth better than Pro1000; however nothing is worth it if mold is involved. I initially started using an iO9 Fall-2021. Since then, I've filed numerous complaints directly to/with OralB: phone calls, emails, and sending original iO9 back to their repair center. Summer-2022 the repair center provided me with a new iO9 handle; and was provided coupons for brushheads. I have following all directions provided by OralB to care for the iO9; and even store the handle & head upside down in a 2-part filtering open dentures container immediately after each usage. I never took the iO9 away from home. I wash & dry my hands before each use. I keep the iO9 away from everything else. I only clean it with toothpaste & tap water. I use a water pick prior to each iO9 use. My dentist sees me twice a month (while in ortho braces) and regular xrays, with no hygiene issues noted nor other dental issues occuring. I keep up with my routine doctor appointments, with all normal test results. I mark on my calendar to start a new brushhead every 2 months. iO9 continued to cause black mold within 1 month of use. No other toothbrushes I've used have mold. Therefore, this mold issue is solely related to iO9.

review.headline: Wow
review.reviewBody: I saw the IO9 on an add somewhere.  I really liked the features.  I thought it probably won't live up to the hype and I was out of my mind to spend this much on a toothbrush.  After a bit of a delay it finally arrived today (7/22). I've used it twice already.  Believe the hype on this.  It's a great brush, great features, and the feeling of clean after use is like I just walked out of a dentists office.

It has been a huge game changer using this toothbrush! Starting with the shape of the circular bristles. It makes complete sense since at the dentist this is similar brush. review.headline: Quiet and sleek, cleans well!
review.reviewBody:
The iO2 is much quieter—l than my previous professional version...no more blasting the TV just to hear over it! The brush head is thicker, feels sturdier, and stays in place better. I also love that the iO2 has a safer, more compact design that fits easily on my shelf (unlike the tall metal piece on the older one).

It only has 3 modes compared to the 6 on my old brush, and I’m not a fan of using the same button for power and mode switching. It also doesn’t show brushing time like the professional one with WiFi and timer.

Still, for daily use, the iO2 is a solid, user-friendly upgrade. It's quieter, sleeker, and just easier to live with.

You don’t need to set it manually. Just: Put the brush in your mouth and press the power button to start brushing. Automatic 2 minute timer with 30 second quadrant alerts — teaches proper brushing duration and coverage without extra effort. Simple, beginner friendly controls and a clear on handle display — easy to use compared with more complex models. review.headline: High-tech toothbrush that provides accuracy info.
review.reviewBody: This is a high-tech toothbrush that makes brushing fun and competitive. It is easy to set up and use. The app, although not necessary, tracks information about your brushing accuracy and challenges you to improve your score much like an exercise app. There are five different modes to choose from and save for future brushings. These include sensitive, extra sensitive, daily clean, whitening, and tongue clean. The base, which serves as the charger and holder for this toothbrush, also provides information about the pressure applied and teeth location of where you are brushing. Yet, this location was not always accurate but may improve the more I use the brush. This inaccuracy can be frustrating if you want to keep track of your progress on the app since it will lower your brushing score. The base also provides an upward counting stopwatch to assure you are brushing thoroughly. Furthermore, the base displays the upper and lower areas of the mouth which help to guide you through the brushing process. Each part lights up white once you have brushed sufficiently in that area. A red light indicates brushing that is too hard and green light is just right amount of pressure. These lights can also be seen on the handle itself. Overall, this brush is a superb brush to provide instant feedback on your brushing habits and keeps you in tune with how you brush. I am eager to see its efficacy at my next dentist visit. Aside from the inaccuracy of the areas of the mouth I am brushing, another con is that the handle does not hold well onto the base which can cause it to accidentally fall onto the floor. This concerns me since we have tile floors and this may cause this brush to break.

review.headline: It like going to the dentist
review.reviewBody: Wow, this is the creme de la creme of toothbrushes. So many features, I am not sure where to even start. You can either get “coaching” from the lights positioned on the base to represent mouth (they will change color and blink when you’ve completed a section) or in the app in a similar manner. 7 cleaning modes, but I’ll be honest I mostly switch between daily and whitening. The brush heads included are a perfect medium bristle that I feel like I’m cleaning but not hurting my gums and teeth. I am definitely brushing longer with it now since it’s guiding me along. It takes a little over 2 mins to complete. And my mouth feels awesome after. I have a feeling at my next dental cleaning I will not hear about missing the insides of my teeth again. Love it!

review.headline: Leaves your mouth feeling dentist clean!
review.reviewBody:
I was very excited about this product, I received the Oral-B iO Series 10 electric tooth brush in cosmic black and I love the color! The toothbrush itself is comfortable to hold and the round brush head is a good size, not too big. 
The magnetic charging stand that comes with it is multi functional, it connects to wifi for use with the app and it connects via bluetooth with the toothbrush. The stand has a timer and works with the toothbrush to show you where to brush, changing the colors of the lights to indicate as each section is completed. Using the stand it takes around 3 hours to charge the toothbrush and the stand can be put in sleep mode by tapping twice and then tap once to wake it up.
The stand, toothbrush and app are all quick and easy to install and setup. And the app is straight forward to use, it can be used instead of the stand to monitor your brushing and can also be setup to tell you when to change your brush. The toothbrush has 7 different brushing modes, including a tongue cleaning mode too. The smart pressure control is indicated by the lights on the neck of the toothbrush or on the stand, red being too much, white being too little and green being perfect! 
A hard charging travel case is also included which is perfect for protecting the toothbrush during travel and it is very handy that it doubles as a charger. Overall the toothbrush gives a great brushing experience, you know you are reaching all your teeth and it leaves your mouth feeling dentist clean, I am very happy with the Oral-B iO Series 10.

review.headline: Best toothbrush I have ever used!
review.reviewBody:
I never thought something as mundane as brushing my teeth could really be improved upon but Oral-B did it. I am 50 years old and have been using mechanical toothbrushes for going on 20 years and I never really thought they could get much better, so I never really looking into the newer brushes but wow I was wrong.

First off in the box we have have the brush itself, four heads, the charging stand and adapter as well as a travel case that also doubles as a charger! There is some good and bad on this but that will be later.

Setup was pretty painless, I downloaded the app using the playstore on my android phone. Connecting the brush was easy and went through the first time. The app will give a lot of information and coaching on how you're brushing but I find simply using the base and watching the light queues and timer as well as the brush itself to be better for me. Head swapping is easy BUT why oh why do we not track multiple users by head swaps??? I would think this could be as easy as adding a small switch on the head to a user 1 or user 2 position OR simply allowing you to choose a second user on the brush itself. If this setting exists I cannot locate it.

Charging using the base is nice and I get the proprietary charge there BUT why did they not make the travel case/charger either include a battery since it uses the same charger port as the base OR better yet use a standard USB-C charger port? When one is traveling it's easy to forget that proprietary charger but everyone has their USB-C charger and if not it's super easy to find one. This is my biggest gripe on the IO-10.

As for how clean my teeth feel after using the IO-10 all I can say is I am impressed, the real time coaching on brushing and the action of the brush has really helped my teeth feel cleaner than I thought possible. Other than the charger shortcoming I am super happy with the IO-10 and am welcoming a new age, for me at least, in tooth care!

review.headline: 5 Stars For Many Reasons
review.reviewBody:
I'm a bit embarrassed to admit how excited I was to try this  OralB iO10 Series Power Toothbrush.  I already was using an electric toothbrush, but this was an upgrade.  The upgrade was only confirmed after using it!

The power electric toothbrush looks very sleek, isn't too heavy and has a smart charger that that is truly intuitive.  The toothbrush utalized lights to easily guide you while brushing to alert you if you're applying too much, not enough or just the right amount of pressure while brushing.  It also has an interactive digital display that lets you select what your brushing goal is such as daily clean, whitening, sensitive gums, tongue cleaning, etc.  It comes with a sleek and compact Magnetic Charger that has lock-in-place stability and provides 3-hour quick charge.  Also included is a travel case so everything is neatly packed and protected when traveling - something I do quite often.  Lastly, there is an extensive list of language options to choose from which I think is amazing!

I've already been raving about this simply luxury to family and close friends so I'm not gatekeeping and sharing with you.  I highly recommend this power electric toothbrush.  I feel the clean as soon as I finish.  My teeth a extra smooth - as soon as my tongue runs over my teeth it feels like I just had a professional cleaning.

Long-term coaching through the app provides progress tracking, brushing goals, and deeper analytics to show how your brushing routine is measuring up.

Does the Oral-B iO Series 10 charger dis: Yes, the iO Sense™ charger displays both a clock and a brushing timer. Here’s how each works: Clock Display: The iO Sense™ smart charger shows the current time when the toothbrush is docked and not in use. The clock is set automatically via Wi-Fi. No manual setup is required. It also adjusts for Daylight Saving Time. Brushing Timer: During brushing, the charger switches to a countdown/elapsed timer display so you can visually track your brushing time. This works alongside the built-in 2-minute timer on the toothbrush handle (which vibrates every 30 seconds to signal a quadrant change).
What’s the difference between Oral-B iO: The iO Sense™ smart charger: The iO Series 10’s headline feature. Six LED panels guide you through 6 mouth sextants in real time, right on the countertop, with no phone needed. More precise pacing: The iO Series 10 divides brushing into 20-second sextant intervals (6 zones) vs. Series 9’s 30-second quadrant intervals (4 zones), for more granular coverage. Quieter operation: The iO Series 10 runs at ~64 dB vs. ~72 dB for Series 9. Fewer brush heads in the box: Series 9 comes with 4 heads; Series 10 includes just 1.
Does the Oral-B iO Series 10 have the sa: Yes. Both models have the same 7 brushing modes, including Daily Clean, Whiten, Gum Care, Sensitive, Super Sensitive, Intense, and Tongue Clean.
How does the Oral-B iO Sense base signal: The Oral B iO Sense™ is equipped with sensors that detect excessive pressure during brushing. When too much force is applied, the toothbrush provides immediate feedback to help you adjust your technique. Here’s how it signals: Visual Alert on the Display: The charging base will show a warning with a change in color to red. Audible cues: The brush emits a subtle audible alert along with the visual signal, reinforcing the message and prompting you to adjust your pressure.

review.headline: Horrible
review.reviewBody: Purchased this brush around May of this year. Brush comes with three replacement heads so that means I would be fine until around February (if replaced every three months). WRONG! Brush heads have to be constantly replaced because they harbor so much mold and junk so leaving the head on the brush is not an option. I started taking the head off but even then it still gets moldy and junky. Brush head doesn't stand on it's own due to the slanted design so all the water stays in there. The app is a whole other problem but save yourself the money and don't purchase this brush! Pictures of brush were taken after cleaning it (which is a daily thing).

review.headline: Terrible Electric Toothbrush Construction!
review.reviewBody: I purchased this toothbrush due to versatility but it was poorly constructed.  There is a gap between the brush and the handle.  Toothpaste gets constantly in the gap causing major mold issues and drops down the side of the toothbrush as seen in the attached photos.  I have to keep the toothbrush in the sink since it seeps through the gap and makes a mess on my bathroom counter.  This is a daily issue.  My family has other Oral B electric toothbrushes (less costly) and the gap has a colored strip.  Initially, I thought my box was missing the colored strip but when I went to the store to see another box I realized that this model does not have a colored strip to enclose the gap. It’s been very frustrating and messy. Also, I used dental wax to form a circle around the gap but it fell off in 1 day.  A Lot of money was spent and I wish I could get my money back and purchase a cheaper, better quality Oral B toothbrush.

review.headline: Flawed Design Causes Mold Growth
review.reviewBody: At a price of $300+, this is the most poorly designed product I have ever purchased.  The point of connection between the brush head and handle is not flush creating a gap between the two pieces that traps moisture between uses despite manually drying the brush.  The grooves at the tip of the handle where it meets the brush head also trap moisture.  As a result and despite proper storage and drying of the toothbrush, both the brush head and tip of the handle serve as a cesspool for mold growth.  I reached out of support, could not have been less helpful, and had no solution to this issue.  On top of the design flaws causing mold issues, the app interface is terrible and the brush does not sync unguided session to the app.  All-in-all, Oral B markets this brush as a quality, app-integrate smart toothbrush when the reality is that its an unconnected mold cesspool.  This is why dentists recommend Phillips and I will never buy an Oral B again.

review.headline: Toothbrush works great - app is IFFY though.
review.reviewBody:
I've been using this toothbrush for a month now, and while I really like the toothbrush, the app has a hard time tracking where you are brushing.  I realize it's got to be pretty sensitive to track physical location in the mouth, but there are obvious things the developers could have done but seem to have failed to do.  For example, if I'm brushing the lower left part of my mouth and the app thinks I'm brushing the lower right part of my mouth, the fact that I move the brush to the right should tell the app that the calibration is off, right?  I've grown tired of "finding the right place to put the toothbrush in my mouth to make it think I've done 100% of my teeth" and have given up on getting good scores in the app.  Maybe a firmware update is coming?  (Not sure how that would be applied though...)

Any way, great brush, moderately OK app.

review.headline: Great Features
review.reviewBody: So I recieved my io series 8 smart electric toothbrush in the mail and I must say it was packaged very nicely. It was very secure. This toothbrush is amazing! I have had a electric toothbrush when I was younger but not as a adult I just brush with a simple toothbrush and I am so amazed with how well this toothbrush operates. It is on point! When I use this it makes my mouth feel so clean which is a plus for me! So I like this toothbrush so much my husband purchased one. He also is in love with it. We would both highly recommend this product to anyone who is looking for a great smart toothbrush that gets in all the right places! So my favorite part of this tooth brush is that it remembers your brushing pattern which is neat. It has 6 smart modes. This can also coach you on alot of things. It has a 2 minute timer that pulsates every 30 seconds with a artificial intelligence capability! This is a just all around great toothbrush! Buy one and you will not be disappointed!

review.headline: Very cool toothbrush
review.reviewBody:
I have never had such a nice electric toothbrush before and I must say I am impressed. It works very well and I really like all the different settings. The charge lasts a while and I like that you can change our the brush heads and then other people could also use. 
Not a huge fan of the app, you have to make sure you have the right one and then it took while for it to sync. I about gave up on it but it finally worked. That would be the downside. You can still it without having the app but then you don't have all the fun other stuff like the tracking, meeting goals etc.

review.headline: Dis-Service
review.reviewBody: Customer service makes it clear they are doing you a favor. A big favor to take your call. Wait time is sometimes over 10 minutes. It took me 45 minutes to have the first service rep actually help me. They were supposed to call me back and never did. While the first rep got a preliminary approval to get me a charging case she needed to confirm with her boss. The second person I spoke to was rude and when I gave her the case number she asked me to repeat the entire story and issue again. Total run around pain in the neck. Buy any place else or anything else. Must say the inexpensive model I first bought is built quite poorly though it has good cleaning power. Having had 3 Phillips Sonicare that never held up I decide to spring for the expensive io8 model with the premium travel case. However, it’s described as a ‘premium travel case’ it’s almost 11” long, bulky, hard-to-pack and has no charger included. Premium?

review.headline: Best toothbrush EVER
review.reviewBody: This toothbrush is seriously life changing!!! There’s so many settings and they’re all super accurate. The whitening is my favorite, my teeth literally shine and sparkle afterwards. The daily clean setting feels like your teeth were cleaned by the dentist office. It even has a sensitive setting which I love for if I ate too much sugar or had too many hot drinks that day to take it easy on my teeth. I’ve been using this toothbrush a little over a week and have gotten compliments from people I see daily on how white my teeth have gotten. If you’re contemplating buying this, DO IT, you’re teeth will never feel more clean. You’ll love it!!!

review.headline: Powerfull toothbrush !!!

I got to say this is one powerfull toothbrush, after the first time i brushed my teeth with it i felt like i had a profesional cleaning at the dentist, my teeth where so clean.It has multible settings and programs. From language to density, length etc. i like the happy/ sad face after you brushed. The charger is magnetic and does a great charge. The travelcase is also very nice..The handle is easy to grab and to use. I am still trying to figure out the bluetooth part.I like the diffrent lightup pressure sensores.This is the best Rechargeable electric toothbrush i ever had and i highly recommend it!

review.headline: Poor engineering.  Overpriced for quality.
review.reviewBody: I bought two of these, one for me and one for my wife.  We loved them!  But for almost $200, there is an expectation of quality and longevity.  After about 2 years, my wife’s stopped taking a charge.  Shortly thereafter, mine started working intermittently and then stopped completely.  It would not even take a charge.  I spoke to Oral B and they said unless I could produce a receipt, they could not help me.  We had moved and there was no way I was going to be able to track that receipt down.  I am an engineer, so naturally I needed to take this apart and see what was happening.  I figured I could put a new aftermarket battery in it.  Well, this is what I found.  The interior electronics were completely corroded!  How could Oral B, a respected dental brand, produce something that is going to be subjected to water and saliva that IS NOT waterproof.  I can buy a lot of regular toothbrushes (or get them for free from my dentist!) for $200.  Very disappointed in the overall quality of this product.  If you care about the environment and product quality, I would not purchase this device.

review.headline: Chic and functional!
review.reviewBody:
This toothbrush is wonderful! I’ve used mine for about a month. I take tooth and gum care pretty seriously and it is- for real- a total “game changer”. First, and I have never said this about a toothbrush, but it is super chic. I have the onyx. It is a deep black, sleek, and expensive looking. It comes with two toothbrush heads, charger, and black carrying case for travel. 
Second, it offers you a superior clean. The two brush heads are different and I use the more gentle one. My teeth just feel clean. It was a bit weird getting used to, my gums did bleed the first two times- but now, it’s very normal. It’s quite a similar feeling to leaving the dentist, but without the grit from professional polish. The brush is Bluetooth enabled and offers a face for length of cleaning. If you do a full two minutes a smiley face appears. It also vibrates at a 30 second mark to switch quadrants. 
Third, it takes up very little space in my bathroom. I like the charging station, I don’t love it. I like things to be a little more stable and this feels like my kids can knock it over easily. 
Finally, this does connect to an app. I did not find the app super useful and ended up deleting it from my phone. It just isn’t me. I did, however, use the travel case it was pretty great. 
Overall, just a really superb toothbrush!

review.headline: Exceptional Toothbrush
review.reviewBody: This Oral-B black iO7 replaced my previous Sonicare toothbrush, and it's an exceptional step up from that other model. The iO7 is extremely comfortable when brushing, and you can actually feel it fitting to the gumline as it cleans. Fantastic. It gives that just-from-the-dentist feeling (in the best sense!). But more than that, it's also beautiful. This thing looks fantastic on the countertop. And the digital display and travel bag are both great bonuses. Highly recommend this one!

review.headline: Shock & Awe!!
review.reviewBody: I have owned a lot of toothbrushes in my time, but this iO Series 7 rechargeable toothbrush is incredible.  It comes with straight forward instuctions, and its easy to set up.  This is compatible with our smart phone and will give us feedback on how we brush our teeth.  There are 5 customizing modes to use when you brush your teeth.  One feature I love is that it will time you while brushing your teeth.  It alerts you when its time to move to the next area to brush.  This feature comes in handy with my son who likes to get through it quickly.  They have a sensitive teeth mode for people like me.  It has made a difference in brushing.  If you are brushing your teeth too hard, it will let you know by lighting up red.  I have been using this gem for 3 weeks, and I have noticed a difference.  My teeth feel cleaner and healthier, and my mouth feels refreshed. It comes with a really nice travel case.   Words can not express how much I love this toothbrush by Oral-B.  I still have a lot to learn, but I truly have been impressed with the results.

review.headline: Top of the line excellent  toothbrush
review.reviewBody: I used  all the setting except intense because  I have sensitive gums.  I love the warning light if you are using  too much pressure.  My mouth feels so much cleaner and fresher  with this brush as opposed to a standard toothbrush.  My gums feel cleaner too.  The Smile and frown is  a cool  feature for timing how long you brush,   I am having a user  error  connecting the bluetooth to my phone.   The  travel case keeps your spare brushes clean and  organized  at home or traveling.

review.headline: Great Brush: TERRIBLE Customer Service on a DEFECT
review.reviewBody: One of 2 brushes works correctly. My wife has the good one.  Mine leaks from the connection between the brush base and handle.  Badly.  Like my arm is covered in spit and toothpaste about 60 seconds after I start brushing.  Worst part?  Oral B refuses to replace the brush.  I’ve used their former series for years and this is. Better toothbrush IF it wasn’t defective, but their service is terrible. Blaming me for “using too much toothpaste” even though I told them my wife’s identical model toothbrush works as designed.  I’m going to “the other brand” and throwing this junk in the trash.  Shame on P&G for refusing to replace a clearly defective product.

review.headline: Mold design flaw
review.reviewBody: There are a lot of great things about this toothbrush, but there is one obvious major flaw that ruins it for me. When you use it, there are holes along the head of the brush that go directly in your mouth and get wet. These holes are IMPOSSIBLE to clean, and when water sits in them it forms mold. So after a few weeks of using this brush, you will literally be able to taste any mold that grows inside the brush head. It's disgusting, unhygienic, and really difficult to work around.

review.headline: Genius improvement on brushing!
review.reviewBody: The Oral-B iO6 Handle electric toothbrush is way more than your average electric toothbrush!! Not only is this a sleek design that takes up minimal counter space (so great for small spaces), but this also comes with an app that connects directly to your toothbrush. Just connect via Bluetooth on your phone and start brushing. The app will show you if you're brushing too hard, too soft, not long enough, etc. and will keep track of your oral health for you. This is literally such a genius invention and my mouth has never felt cleaner. The brush tip is the perfect size and I'm so extremely happy with this I'll be telling everyone I know about it!

review.headline: I like the built-in display I also like the smiley
review.reviewBody: I bought the Oral-B IO6 and I love the cleaning quality of it. I love how it has the inbuilt app to tell you where you need to work on brushing. I like how it has a display that greets you in the morning and greets you at night and I just love everything about it. I like how it has fast magnetic charger.

review.headline: My Teeth Feel Super Clean!
review.reviewBody: The Oral-B iO Series 6 is the best electric toothbrush I have ever used. It leaves my teeth feeling super clean, and the pressure sensor helps me to not over-brush. The display is super bright and easy to read the different cleaning modes. It looks sleek and the battery lasts a long time. Charging is as simple as can be by just putting the toothbrush on the post. The blue light illuminates my bathroom when I brush in the dark, a fun bonus feature. I highly recommend the Oral-B Series 6 toothbrush, its my new favorite. You won't regret it.

review.headline: Love this toothbrush!
review.reviewBody: This tooth brush is very sleek and the perfect size for my hand. I did find it to be VERY loud so I don't recommend using it while there are people sleeping. The battery life is fantastic on it, I charge it about once a week! I love the coverage guide in the app, it makes for getting an entire mouth clean feeling! I have noticed a big improvement in my gum help as well.

review.headline: Healthier and cleaner teeth
review.reviewBody: The Oral-B iO6 offers an impressive blend of performance and value. Its cleaning power is excellent, leaving your teeth feeling dentist-fresh with every use, thanks to its smart pressure sensor and multiple brushing modes. The noise level is noticeably quieter than older models, making for a more pleasant brushing experience. With its sleek, modern design and intuitive display, it looks great on the bathroom counter. The battery life lasts up to two weeks on a single charge, and for the features you get, the price is quite reasonable. A smart investment for healthier, cleaner teeth.

review.headline: Worth the upgrade!
review.reviewBody: I absolutely love this toothbrush! I had an older oral-b electric toothbrush, and was due for an upgrade. I love the functionality of this one, and the many different options it has for brushing. I personally like the daily clean and sensitive options, but there’s great ones to choose from. I also love the app that goes along with it and how it shows how well you brushed each area and what areas you should focus on. The battery lasts a really long time, and I love that the charger is the same as the older oral b toothbrushes so my husband and I don’t have to have multiple chargers on the bathroom counter. Overall, my mouth, gums, and teeth feel so much cleaner and healthier since upgrading to this device! Would highly recommend!

review.headline: Great Features !
review.reviewBody: This toothbrush is like having your own personal assistant brushing your teeth, seriously ! First thing I noticed when I opened it was the smart display screen. It greets you with a Hello as soon as you turn it on and then you select a language. There are several options to choose from when brushing your teeth such as sensitive etc. I really appreciate that because with sensitive teeth that setting allows me to brush my teeth properly without worrying about tooth pain. It automatically detects when you pick it up too ! It comes with a charging port that you can plug in to any outlet. To get the maximum benefits you download the Oral B app and connect it to your Bluetooth and it automatically detects your brushing and even tells you if you're brushing too hard, or too soft. The light on the toothbrush will also change colors to indicate this; if it turns red you are brushing too hard. It takes a little getting used to with all the fancy technology but once you get comfortable there's no going back!

review.headline: It’s a nice toothbrush.. but….
review.reviewBody:
Just bought this toothbrush today and tired it out as soon as I got home. While it’s a nice tooth this overall and my teeth actually feel very clean, I tried two different settings.. the whitening and daily clean options, and I couldn’t tell a single difference in the vibration speed. I assumed that the whitening would be a “stronger feel”, but they both felt exactly the same and in my opinion felt a little too harsh on my teeth. 
Like I said, overall I think this brush cleaned my teeth really well, but I think for as much as this brush is it should actually have different speeds for the option you want to use.

review.headline: Love My New Toothbrush!!!
review.reviewBody:
The Oral-B IO series is very nice and doing a good job.  The toothbrush has a lot of features, bell and whistles too. This was my first experience with an Oral-B round toothbrush and I’m pleased. 

The instructing are easy to understand and there is also a phone app for the brush too. My toothbrush came with the device, brush head, charging cord and a carry case.

My favorite thing about the brush is the lighted pressure sensor, red too hard and green is correct. The brush cleans like no other I’ve had, especially around my back teeth including my wisdom teeth. It has a two minute timer and beeps every 30 second to change brush position, I found out I wasn’t brushing long enough. The brush does feels bigger in my mouth but, I think it does a better job. 

The brush has different setting I change between different setting but I prefer the intense and mix with the whitening. My teeth feel like I just left the dentist office, clean. 

I’ve had no problems with the toothbrush, teeth or gums and it feels good taking care of my teeth and gums properly. I’ve already bought replacements heads and I’m enjoying brushing my teeth.

review.headline: Great set, clean teeth
review.reviewBody:
I have been using oral B electric toothbrushes for years and can’t live without them. I get clean, dentist clean teeth. Manual toothbrushes just doesn’t clean the same way.

I love this new smart one, it works with the oral- B app. You can keep track of your dental health. The app connected to my toothbrush via Bluetooth in seconds. It lets you personalize your toothbrush, like the color of the smart ring, modes, timers, plus brushing habits. It even has challenges where you could earn badges. It’s cool.

The toothbrush itself is great, it’s got different clean modes, i ,Ike gentle. It buzzes so you know when to move from area to area. It also let’s you know when it needs charging and when it’s done plus plus more.

I am happy the brush is round, I don’t like the rectangle shape. I prefer round toothbrush heads, It’s perfect size to get in the back of my mouth and I like to do each teeth to make sure they are really clean. My only wish is it was the same toothbrush heads as my old toothbrush so I could use the ones I already own. Oh well.

I love this set comes with two of everything, one for me and one to share. The travel cases are great as I do travel sometimes for two weeks at a time and I always take my electric toothbrush. I usually wrap them in my towels. I would have to now with the traveling case, it has a place for the handle and for two brush heads, they snap into place so no dancing around.

I am happy with it all so far.

This is an excellent toothbrush! The charge holds for so long & it charges fast when you do need to charge it! I love the design and the specific toothbrush head I chose is for gums, which has been great. It really hugs your teeth AND gums, gentle but very effective cleaning and it has different speeds. I like that it comes with a carrying case as well and it fits perfectlyinside and offers protection when youre packing your toiletries or if you wanted to store it in your drawer or laying down. Its also is nice to keep the toothbrush in when not in use at home so it doesnt get knocked over in the floor or on the countertop. 
 It comes with a small charging station, charger and the head, I just wish the component that you put the toothbrush on to charge was weighted so when you take the toothbrush off, it doesn't slide around or get pulled off the cabinet. This may be because it has a longer cord on it which makes it pull on the charging station. This could be nice if you don't have an outlet close to your countertop though. In my opinion, either the cord shouldn't be as heavy or the station itself shouldn't so lightweight.

review.reviewBody: I am in love with this toothbrush! I love this toothbrush it helps me stay on track with brushing my teeth! The Oral-B iO Series 4 Electric Toothbrush, let you customize your cleaning to your liking in four brushes modes: Daily Clean, Whiten, Sensitive, and Super Sensitive and, it's rechargeable! The small brush reaches all areas, so much easier to clean back teeth and behind my lower bottom teeth no longer feel plaque build up and teeth are definitely white. I love the 30 second intervals it makes it so easy to make sure I don't skip any area and The 2 minute timer is a nice bonus. Really does a great job at getting where you need it most. This unit is also "Bluetooth" enabled, so with added cellphone app (free to download), you can also monitor how you are brushing and possibly correct any areas you may be missing. The battery lasts for almost 2 weeks, even though I brush more than the 2 minute minimum they recommend. The charging base is nice and small, so very portable for travel. My teeth feel just like I left the dental hygenist every day. I would 100% recommend!

review.headline: Game changer!
review.reviewBody: Talk about game changer, this oral b i04 Handel electronic toothbrush is hands down the best. It cleans your teeth like never before.  It has an app you can download for free. It attaches thru your Bluetooth so easy. It has many great features.  It also has a really nice carrying case for traveling.  It has a great plug in charger so you don't have to keep buying batteries.  The charger is also not big and bulky and doesn't take up much room. Overall I am so pleased with this electronic toothbrush. I couldn't have picked a better one. So if you are looking for a really great electronic toothbrush,  oral b io4 is where it's at. You will love it! Your teeth will thank you.

review.headline: Makes Brushing Teeth Enjoyable
review.reviewBody:
I like that it is a swirling circle brush so that I can brush each tooth individually. You can really feel the bristles going over your teeth and gums.

The toothbrush has five levels -- whitening, daily clean, sensitive, super sensitive and intense.

It makes color changes just below the brush stem to let you know if your over brushing (pressure) teeth.

The brush head for everyday use, per the directions, will likely be changed out every three months. 

There is an app for this device to track your daily brushing habits. I already know I brush my teeth daily, sometimes two and three times a day, so I did not do this. 

It takes roughly 16 hours for a full charge, after depleting it to 0% power (per the instruction booklet). I have never let it go down to zero, so I don't know how long it takes to get there. But I will say, I have let it go a few days without charging and it works just fine. So to me, this means it is good for traveling, and even comes with a carrying case. 

It comes with a 2 year limited warranty.

review.headline: Sleek and portable
review.reviewBody: Really love the black sleek design, the travel case, and that it comes with a charger too. Oral B always has amazing dental products . Highly recommend.

The round brush head reaches all areas of my mouth and leaves my teeth feeling very smooth. I also noticed that my breath stays fresher for longer. The battery life is good, and it charges quickly with the magnetic charger.

review.headline: Oral B iO electric toothbrush showed me what real clean teeth should feel like!
review.reviewBody: Thank you Influenster and Oral B for my complementary toothbrush. I just want to say how embarrassed I feel for how I have been brushing my teeth! It has been a huge game changer using this toothbrush! Starting with the shape of the circular bristles. It makes complete sense since at the dentist this is similar brush. Also the fact that it has a pressure sensor is extremely helpful. I tend to very heavy handed when it comes to anything. The two minute timer is also useful as a reminder to keep brushing. It is waterproof and comes with two brush heads. The fact that I can charge it I am in love with this toothbrush! Thank you Oral B for looking out for my teeth!

review.headline: Quiet and sleek, cleans well!
review.reviewBody:
The iO2 is much quieter—l than my previous professional version...no more blasting the TV just to hear over it! The brush head is thicker, feels sturdier, and stays in place better. I also love that the iO2 has a safer, more compact design that fits easily on my shelf (unlike the tall metal piece on the older one).

It only has 3 modes compared to the 6 on my old brush, and I’m not a fan of using the same button for power and mode switching. It also doesn’t show brushing time like the professional one with WiFi and timer.

Still, for daily use, the iO2 is a solid, user-friendly upgrade. It's quieter, sleeker, and just easier to live with.

review.headline: A well-built, comfortable Oral-B with three cleaning speeds and a really nice American Eagles design🦅
review.reviewBody: I’ve used Oral-B electric toothbrushes before, so l wasn’t surprised that l liked this one too. The brush feels well made, sits comfortably in my hand and the three cleaning speeds make it easy to choose what feels right. The controls are simple and the brush feels solid without being awkward or too bulky. I also really like the American Eagle design 🦅- it makes the toothbrush look less generic and more personal. Oral b is one of brand I often look at when choosing a toothbrush and this one a good example of why: it feels reliable, practical and well thought out for everyday use. Maintenance is straightforward and the overall size is comfortable for regular brushing.

review.headline: Great cowboys electric toothbrush
review.reviewBody: Great electric toothbrush! And love that it is cowboys themed too. Perfect for the start of the NFL season. It has three brush setting speeds. It has high tech, pressing too hard on your teeth, the brush will slow down to help protect gums and enamel. The battery life is great. No need to charge it everyday if you can’t. It lasts up to two weeks depending on how much you use it. Great for traveling as well. Charging is easy as well. Jut set it down on the charger and the light will appear. Right now it is green showing a full charge. Also comes with a welcome guide in case you have never used an electric brush before. Love that it has a vibration every 30 seconds letting you know until you make it to the two minutes. I definitely recommend, this brand makes great brushes!

review.headline: Thus toothbrush is worth it!
review.reviewBody: I like the Oral-B iO2 Electric Toothbrush! My teeth feel clean after every use. And with it round head I can brush my wisdom tooth! I always have a problem with rectangle toothbrush, but now it’s way easier. Also it has 3 different cleaning settings, 2 minutes timer and automatic gum/tooth pressure sensor! The noise on the 3 level is a lil bit laud but not that someone can hear that you brushing your teeth. And of course you can buy new iO series heads. What else I like about it, that the battery life is pretty long. After I charged my toothbrush I put away the charging station and it’s been 10 days and my toothbrush is still going! I recommend the Oral-B iO Series 2!

review.headline: Great product
review.reviewBody: I’m very happy with the Oral B iO2 49ers Edition. it has a sleek design and feels comfortable to use. The brushing power is strong enough to clean teeth well while still being gentle on the gums. i also like the design  it makes the toothbrush look unique and fun. The rechargeable battery convenient and the compact design makes it easy to use every day. Overall, this is great electric toothbrush for everyone looking for better cleaning without spending too much.

review.headline: Good overall
review.reviewBody: Thanks @influenster. The Oral-B iO2 NFL 49ers edition looks awesome for any fan. The red and gold design stands out and feels unique. It adds a fun team spirit. The toothbrush itself looks great and works really well. The cleaning feels thorough and gentle. The brush is easy to use and doesn’t make lots of noise. Thr brush is also ergonomic. The handle feels comfortable to hold with a smooth grip that makes brushing easier and more controlled

review.headline: Comfort and Long Lasting
review.reviewBody: My dentist has been recommending an electric tooth brush for a while, he says it just does a better job no matter how long I brush for. Trying the Oral B i02 series was definitely a plus. Not only do I get to represent my favorite football team...GO BUCS...but with the different speeds and softness of the brush, I feel like oral hygiene just got a boost. The brush is comfortable and does not hurt my gums, and the design is easy for me to get all the way in the back. The battery lasts a long time, so I can even take it away for the weekend without the charger. I would definitely recommend this toothbrush.
